bullets: Migrated the authentication system from JWT-based auth to Appwrite’s cookie-based session model, rebuilding all 7 auth flows: login, signup, logout and Google/GitHub OAuth across the application.

Rebuilt the platform’s entire UI from scratch in Astro using React, Tailwind CSS, and DaisyUI, redesigning core dashboards and building 10+ chart types with Chart.js, including custom visualizations to deliver a more modern, consistent, and intuitive interface.
Building a repository-wide vectorization pipeline that ingests an entire codebase into embeddings to power autonomous issue resolution, applying RAG architecture patterns from prior work on Illume.
